scope: Candidate 11 completed supplemental source-caret and vector/legend reachability pixel review
reviewStatus: All 48 listed originals actually reviewed; requested endpoint/legend content visible. Supplemental evidence only.

conditions.x11Canvas: 1600x1100; black area outside upper-left application is desktop canvas

observations: All eight source End/Home X11 positions show the caret inside the editor.
All 24 vector endpoint X11 shots contain the requested upper/lower visible boundary; opposite ends may legitimately be outside the scroll viewport.
All eight legend X11 shots show both full labels and percentages.
The windowed flow-bottom screenshots show real drawn completion nodes and bottom outlines, not the blank preview seen in the earlier candidate 10 failure.
Eight windowed WebView originals agree with their paired X11 application regions.
limitations: This review concerns the listed completed reachability run; it does not certify the concurrently running formal matrix or overall acceptance.
Static endpoint screenshots corroborate the saved positions and visible content; they do not alone prove continuous wheel behavior between frames.
No claim that a large graph or pie plus its legend fits simultaneously at 200% in a narrow window.
Earlier candidate 10 failures remain separate retained evidence and are not overwritten or reclassified.
No product, test, original image, browser, native UI or build was modified or started for this review.
